source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Developing Responsible Technology (PDF 118, printed 114).

blocks.text: Responsible innovation (zimmedarana ijaad) ka matlab sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai par dhyan dena hai. Technologies aisi banayi jayein jo zindagi ka miyar behtar karein, mauqe paida karein aur nuqsan kam karein. System banate waqt developers ko lambe arse ke samaji aur mahoolyati (environmental) asraat sochne chahiye, taake technology sab bastiyon ko barabar faida de.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Behtareen technologies logon ko pehle rakhti hain; akhlaqiyat aur hamdardi (empathy) nayi ijaad ke aham ajza hain.

blocks.prompt: Responsible innovation ka matlab kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf maali munafe (financial gains) ke bajaye insani bhalai (human welfare) par dhyan dena: zindagi behtar karna, mauqe paida karna, nuqsan kam karna, aur lambe arse ke samaji aur mahoolyati asraat ka khayal rakhna.

items: Responsible technology: logon ko pehle rakhna; ethics aur empathy (hamdardi) nayi ijaad ke zaroori ajza.
